lina_cs: Hey team — BrightMart (ticket #BM-8182) reports that after last night's model rollout some responses now start with raw HTML tags (e.g.,

, ) and that is breaking their client-side parser. They included a minimal chat log and want a repro + hotfix. sam_eng: can you paste the exact request_ids and their example? I'll check routing and variant. lina_cs: sure. from their ticket: ``` User: \"How much will shipping cost for 2 boxes to CA?\" Response: \"

Shipping: $12.50

\" ``` request_ids: r_202604020745_02, r_202604020751_11 deploy-bot: Rollout finished: model_id=redwood-gen-4.2, variant=prod-qt8, start=2026-04-02T00:30Z, completed=2026-04-02T02:15Z marta_ml: interesting. I ran a quick check and see an uptick in tokens for HTML-like tokens in the telemetry after 4.2. josh_sre: @lina_cs do they run server-side sanitization or do they rely on the raw output? If they rely on our output being plain text we should treat this as a regression. lina_cs: they said they expected plain text and their parser fails when tags present. They provided curl too: ``` curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer ' \ -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-4.2","input":"How much will shipping cost for 2 boxes to CA?","max_tokens":40}' ``` Response (redacted): ``` {"id":"r_202604020751_11","model":"redwood-gen-4.2","output":"

Shipping: $12.50

","latency_ms":280} ``` sam_eng: I can reproduce locally against prod-qt8 using the same prompt — ~40% of runs include HTML wrappers. Prod-qt7 returns plain text strings. This sounds variant-specific. marta_ml: I'll diff the system prompt and few-shot examples from 4.1->4.2. There was a small change in the content formatting examples (we added an example where answers were formatted in HTML for a demo page). That could explain the model preference for HTML wrappers. josh_sre: if that's the cause we should revert that formatting example or alter the system prompt to prefer plain text. Meanwhile we can pin BrightMart's routing to prod-qt7. sam_eng: agreed. Proposed mitigation steps: 1) Pin BrightMart (customer id redacted) to redwood-gen-4.1/prod-qt7 in routing for their account. 2) Roll back the formatting example in the system prompt and push a small patch to 4.2 canary asap. 3) Provide BrightMart a short client-side sanitization snippet as a stopgap. lina_cs: I'll ask BrightMart to run two quick prompts (A/B) and share results + any extra request_ids. Also asking for timestamps of failing calls. marta_ml: opened PR to remove the HTML example from system prompt and flagged for expedited review by product. If approved we can cut a patched canary within the hour. josh_sre: I'll pull token-level logs for r_202604020745_02 and r_202604020751_11 and attach traces to the ticket so we have evidence for the customer. lina_cs: thanks all. I'll update BrightMart with the mitigation (pin + client sanitize) and tell them we expect a canary patch soon. Marking ticket as high-priority and requesting a follow-up once the canary lands. :pray:
